summary: Iter94 CheerPlanner 2.0 (Review Photos + Near-a-Comp). Backend fully verified via pytest — 6/6 pass: POST /api/reviews accepts up to 3 base64 photos and CAPS extras at 3; PATCH /api/reviews/{id} adds photos and CLEARS with []; GET /api/reviews/places/{id} returns `photos` on each review row; GET /api/reviews/near?competition_id={id} correctly returns Round Rock reviewed place (Kalahari Resort, Round Rock, TX -> Kids Cafe seed matched) and returns {location, places:[]} shape; missing competition returns 404. Frontend UI partly verified — /reviews/new page loads (auth-gated) and the 'Photos (optional)' PhotoGallery renders with testID review-photos-add visible in the mobile screenshot; code review of /reviews/[id].tsx confirms review-photo-{i} thumbs, fullscreen Modal viewer (Pressable backdrop closes) and openEditor() pre-fills existing photos into PhotoGallery with testIDPrefix=detail-review-photos; code review of /competitions/[id].tsx confirms nearPlaces are fetched on load via /reviews/near, renders near-place-{id} cards linking to /reviews/{id}, and near-see-all pushes /reviews?city={comp.location}. Deep click-through UI flow through login form hit a script locator issue (login submit label is 'Sign in', not 'Log in') — not an app bug, and the backend/photos code paths are fully validated. No React Native issues, no deprecated packages, no design/testID/component bugs discovered.
critical_code_review_comments: reviews.py /api/reviews/near: uses regex on every alphanumeric word in the comp's location — for very common tokens (e.g., 'TX', 'Resort') it could over-match, but STOP set + US_STATES + len>=3 filter mitigates. Good defensive design.
PhotoGallery caps at max=3 client-side and backend also caps at 3 — defense in depth. Consistent testID pattern (add / thumb-N / remove-N).
/reviews/[id].tsx photoStrip: uses index as key (`key={i}`) — fine since photos are re-fetched from server after mutation.
competitions/[id].tsx line 99: the near-fetch try/catch swallows all errors silently; consider logging in dev only. Non-blocking.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% (Photos gallery on /reviews/new visually confirmed; other flows verified via code review + backend round-trip. Deep UI click-through blocked by test-script login form label mismatch, not an app bug).

seed_data_creation: Ephemeral TEST_Photos_*, TEST_PhotoCap_*, TEST_PhotoEdit_*, TEST_KidsCafe_RR, TEST_UI*_KidsCafe_RR review places and TEST_UI*_Comp_RR competitions created and cleaned up in-test. A few TEST_UI4 artifacts may linger in DB due to script abort — labeled with TEST_ prefix so easy to identify/clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent: For UI login on this project, the button reads 'Sign in' (not 'Log in') and the login page is /login. AsyncStorage on web uses IndexedDB (not localStorage), so injecting a token via localStorage.setItem does not authenticate the app — must go through UI login. Photos are stored as base64 data URLs (client-compressed via expo-image-manipulator to MAX_EDGE=1280, quality 0.5), consistent with athlete avatars/receipts pattern. /api/reviews/near returns {location, places[]} — cap 12, sorted by avg_rating desc, review_count desc; frontend slice(0,5). testID patterns: review-photos-add / review-photos-thumb-N / review-photos-remove-N on /reviews/new; detail-review-photos-add / -thumb-N / -remove-N in the edit editor on /reviews/[id]; review-photo-N on review cards (opens fullscreen Pressable-backdrop modal); near-place-{placeId} + near-see-all on /competitions/[id]. Backend base URL is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs. Iter93 photos + near-a-comp features are correctly implemented end-to-end at the API layer; the PhotoGallery UI renders correctly with the expected testIDs on the compose screen.
